title: Preventing Safety Drift in Large Language Models via Coupled Weight and Activation Constraints
reasoning: The paper presents a technical method (CWAC) to preserve safety alignment in Large Language Models during fine-tuning. While it uses safety benchmarks (like HarmBench and JailbreakBench) to evaluate the model's refusal behavior toward harmful prompts (e.g., building bombs or bioweapons), it does not evaluate or benchmark specific religious traditions, formal moral reasoning frameworks, or ethical systems.
